info_recording: Recording mouse and keyboard… Press the hotkey or the button to stop.
hint_coordinates: Pick on screen or type them
msg_tray_unavailable: System tray unavailable; closing the window will quit Otoshi.
msg_ui_error: An unexpected error occurred. See the log file for details.
msg_hotkeys_failed: Could not register {hotkeys}. Choose other hotkeys in Settings.
msg_no_macro: Record or open a macro first.
already_running: Otoshi is already running. Look for its icon in the system tray.
tray_hint: Otoshi keeps running in the tray. Hotkeys still work.
err_speed_number: Speed must be a number, e.g. 1.5x.
hk_err_unsupported: {key} cannot be used as a hotkey.
hk_err_modifier_only: Add a regular key to the modifier (for example Ctrl+F2).
hk_err_typing: A single typing key would fire while you type. Use an F-key or add a modifier.
hk_err_f12: Windows reserves F12. Add a modifier or choose another key.
hk_err_in_use: {hotkey} is already used by another program.
mf_too_large: The file is too large to be an Otoshi macro.
mf_not_macro: This is not an Otoshi macro file.
mf_newer: This macro was saved by a newer Otoshi version.
mf_empty: The macro file contains no playable events.
mf_legacy_unsafe: This old-format macro file could not be read safely.
desc_overlay: Small always-on-top indicator that shows the current mode
desc_close_to_tray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
desc_hotkeys: Work everywhere, even when Otoshi is in the background
page_macro_desc: Record and replay mouse and keyboard input
page_clicker_desc: Click automatically at a fixed interval
hint_loop_delay: Wait time after each repeat, 0 = none
desc_humanize: Adds small random variations to timing and click position
hint_humanize_time: Each delay varies by up to this amount, 0 = off
hint_humanize_pos: Click position shifts by up to this many pixels, 0 = off
hint_interval_max: The interval is randomized up to this value, 0 = fixed
hint_hold_key: Click, then press the key or combination to hold
msg_hold_no_key: Choose a key to hold first.
msg_hold_key_is_hotkey: {hotkey} is an Otoshi hotkey and cannot be held.
desc_start_with_windows: Launch Otoshi when you sign in
desc_start_in_tray: Open hidden in the tray instead of showing the window
desc_finish_sound: Play a sound when playback or the clicker finishes
desc_finish_notification: Show a system notification when playback or the clicker finishes
msg_autostart_failed: Could not change the Windows startup setting.
macro_hint: Press Record ({hotkey}) to capture mouse and keyboard input.
